note: Set A correctly identifies window tags (e.g., 1.07, 1.06) as identifiers, whereas Set B mislabels them as dimensions, which is a significant attribute error. Set A has fewer trivial duplicate claims, such as repeating floor elevations with minor unit variations found in Set B. Although Set B is more precise on the PV array grid location (4-5 vs 4-6), Set A's overall attribute accuracy and lower noise level make it superior.
